panels.title: Processing activity — cumulative successful operations
panels.description: Recorded operations, not sampled queue depth. Each consumer instance has its own line and starts a new count on restart. Includes retries and duplicate results, not unique images. The first export may already be 1; a rise requires a later operation. Allow the consumer export interval (60 seconds by default) plus dashboard refresh.

panels.title: Jobs queue — sampled backlog
panels.description: SQS counts are approximate. Missing/failed or >90-second-old observations are hidden, never replaced with zero. Replica readings use max, not sum. This is current backlog, not completed work. Jobs processed between 15-second samples may never appear; see activity counters below.

targets.expr: max by (state) ((watermarker_queue_depth{source="jobs"}) and on (instance, source) ((watermarker_backlog_observation_success == 1) and on (instance, source) (time() - watermarker_backlog_observation_time_seconds < 90)))

panels.title: Results queue — sampled backlog
panels.description: SQS counts are approximate. Missing/failed or >90-second-old observations are hidden, never replaced with zero. Replica readings use max, not sum. This is current backlog, not completed work. Jobs processed between 15-second samples may never appear; see activity counters below.

targets.expr: max by (state) ((watermarker_queue_depth{source="results"}) and on (instance, source) ((watermarker_backlog_observation_success == 1) and on (instance, source) (time() - watermarker_backlog_observation_time_seconds < 90)))

panels.title: Dead-letter queues — total messages
panels.description: SQS counts are approximate. Missing/failed or >90-second-old observations are hidden, never replaced with zero. Replica readings use max, not sum. Includes visible, in-flight and delayed messages.

targets.expr: sum by (source) (max by (source, state) ((watermarker_queue_depth{source=~"jobs_dlq|results_dlq"}) and on (instance, source) ((watermarker_backlog_observation_success == 1) and on (instance, source) (time() - watermarker_backlog_observation_time_seconds < 90))))

panels.title: Pending outbox jobs
panels.description: All committed intents, including delayed retries. Drops when SQS accepts a job; does not mean processing completed.

targets.expr: max ((watermarker_outbox_pending) and on (instance, source) ((watermarker_backlog_observation_success == 1) and on (instance, source) (time() - watermarker_backlog_observation_time_seconds < 90)))

panels.title: Oldest pending outbox job
panels.description: Age since the image row was created; retries do not reset it. Zero means the outbox was successfully observed empty.

targets.expr: max ((watermarker_outbox_oldest_age_seconds) and on (instance, source) ((watermarker_backlog_observation_success == 1) and on (instance, source) (time() - watermarker_backlog_observation_time_seconds < 90)))

panels.title: Observation age
panels.description: Time since each source was checked, including failed checks. Above 90s means stale. No data means the monitor has not exported recently.

panels.title: Source checks — 1 OK / 0 failed
panels.description: Read errors are not empty queues. Inspect watermarker-monitor logs for failed sources. Keep monitor running during outage experiments.

panels.title: Successful job publishes since consumer start
panels.description: Cumulative successful operations from currently exporting consumer instances. Resets on restart and includes retries/duplicate handling; not a count of unique completed images.

panels.title: Successful result handlers since consumer start
panels.description: Cumulative successful operations from currently exporting consumer instances. Resets on restart and includes retries/duplicate handling; not a count of unique completed images.
